name: Paint bucket
summary: Open paint tin with a wire handle, paint on the surface and a drip down the side; colour is set by a param.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom centre: the tin stands on the floor at y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the item is hero size (about 420 px tall); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: drip = the drip down the side grows longer and restarts

author: krakujs
